      "unit": "F001",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "applicability_explanation": "Provides the baseline permission to accumulate waste in satellite accumulation areas without specified permits or standard requirements, conditioned upon meeting the rule's exemption conditions.",
        "statement": "A generator may accumulate as much as fifty-five gallons of non-acute hazardous waste and either one quart of liquid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or one kilogram (kg) (2.2 pounds) of solid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code in containers at or near any point of generation where wastes initially accumulate which is under the control of the operator of the process generating the waste, without a permit or permit by rule and without complying with the requirements of Chapters 3745-50, 3745-54 to 3745-57 and 3745-205, 3745-65 to 3745-69 and 3745-256, 3745-266, and 3745-267 of the Administrative Code, provided that all of the conditions for exemption in rule 3745-52-15 are met, and may comply with these conditions for exemption instead of complying with the conditions for exemption in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, except as required in paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of this rule.",

        ]

      "unit_attributes": {
        "applicability_explanation": "Inherits applicability as a condition for exemption under satellite accumulation from paragraph (A).",
        "statement": "As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, if a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak, the generator shall immediately transfer the hazardous waste from this container to a container that is in good condition and does not leak, or immediately transfer and manage the waste in a central accumulation area operated in compliance with paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",

        "statement": "As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, the generator shall use a container made of or lined with materials that will not react with, and are otherwise compatible with, the hazardous waste to be accumulated, so that the ability of the container to contain the waste is not impaired.",

        "statement": "As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, incompatible wastes, or incompatible wastes and materials, (see appendix to rule 3745-66-99 of the Administrative Code for examples) shall not be placed in the same container, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.",

        "applicability_explanation": "Subparagraph (A)(3)(b) establishes a prohibition against placing hazardous waste into unwashed containers previously holding incompatible wastes/materials.",
        "statement": "As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, hazardous waste shall not be placed in an unwashed container that previously held an incompatible waste or material (see appendix to rule 3745-66-99 of the Administrative Code for examples), unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.",

        "statement": "A generator who accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15 at or near any point of generation shall do either of the following: (a) within three consecutive calendar days, comply with the applicable central accumulation area requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; or (b) remove the excess from the satellite accumulation area within three consecutive calendar days to either a central accumulation area operated in accordance with the applicable requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, an on-site permit by rule or permitted treatment, storage, or disposal facility, or an off-site designated facility.",

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Provides the baseline permission to accumulate waste in satellite accumulation areas without specified permits or standard requirements, conditioned upon meeting the rule's exemption conditions.
unit_attributes.statement: A generator may accumulate as much as fifty-five gallons of non-acute hazardous waste and either one quart of liquid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or one kilogram (kg) (2.2 pounds) of solid acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code in containers at or near any point of generation where wastes initially accumulate which is under the control of the operator of the process generating the waste, without a permit or permit by rule and without complying with the requirements of Chapters 3745-50, 3745-54 to 3745-57 and 3745-205, 3745-65 to 3745-69 and 3745-256, 3745-266, and 3745-267 of the Administrative Code, provided that all of the conditions for exemption in rule 3745-52-15 are met, and may comply with these conditions for exemption instead of complying with the conditions for exemption in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, except as required in paragraphs (A)(7) and (A)(8) of this rule.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Inherits applicability as a condition for exemption under satellite accumulation from paragraph (A).
unit_attributes.statement: As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, if a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak, the generator shall immediately transfer the hazardous waste from this container to a container that is in good condition and does not leak, or immediately transfer and manage the waste in a central accumulation area operated in compliance with paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If a container holding hazardous waste is not in good condition, or if the container begins to leak.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Applies as a condition for satellite accumulation exemption under paragraph (A).
unit_attributes.statement: As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, the generator shall use a container made of or lined with materials that will not react with, and are otherwise compatible with, the hazardous waste to be accumulated, so that the ability of the container to contain the waste is not impaired.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Subparagraph (A)(3)(a) establishes a prohibition against placing incompatible wastes or materials in the same container under the satellite accumulation rules.
unit_attributes.statement: As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, incompatible wastes, or incompatible wastes and materials, (see appendix to rule 3745-66-99 of the Administrative Code for examples) shall not be placed in the same container, unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Subparagraph (A)(3)(b) establishes a prohibition against placing hazardous waste into unwashed containers previously holding incompatible wastes/materials.
unit_attributes.statement: As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, hazardous waste shall not be placed in an unwashed container that previously held an incompatible waste or material (see appendix to rule 3745-66-99 of the Administrative Code for examples), unless paragraph (B) of rule 3745-65-17 of the Administrative Code is complied with.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Subparagraph (A)(3)(c) governs containers holding hazardous waste incompatible with other wastes/materials nearby.
unit_attributes.statement: As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, a container holding a hazardous waste that is incompatible with any waste or other materials accumulated nearby in other containers shall be separated from the other materials or protected from the incompatible waste or material by any practical means.
unit_attributes.scope_text: A container holding a hazardous waste that is incompatible with any waste or other materials accumulated nearby in other containers.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Paragraph (A)(4) mandates closing containers during accumulation, subject to specific exceptions in (a) and (b).
unit_attributes.statement: As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, a container holding hazardous waste shall be closed at all times during accumulation, except when adding, removing, or consolidating waste, or when temporary venting of a container is necessary for the proper operation of equipment or to prevent dangerous situations, such as build-up of extreme pressure.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Paragraph (A)(5) mandates container marking and labeling, including both the words 'Hazardous Waste' and an indication of hazards.
unit_attributes.statement: As a condition for satellite accumulation exemption, a generator shall mark or label the generator's container with the words "Hazardous Waste" and an indication of the hazards of the contents [examples include, but are not limited to, the applicable hazardous waste characteristics (i.e., ignitable, corrosive, reactive, toxic); hazard communication consistent with the department of transportation requirements at 49 CFR Part 172 subpart E (labeling) or subpart F (placarding); a hazard statement or pictogram consistent with the occupational safety and health administration hazard communication standard at 29 CFR 1910.1200; or a chemical hazard label consistent with the national fire protection association code 704].

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Paragraph (A)(6) sets out requirements when accumulation amounts exceed the limits in paragraph (A).
unit_attributes.statement: A generator who accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15 at or near any point of generation shall do either of the following: (a) within three consecutive calendar days, comply with the applicable central accumulation area requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code; or (b) remove the excess from the satellite accumulation area within three consecutive calendar days to either a central accumulation area operated in accordance with the applicable requirements in paragraph (B) of rule 3745-52-16 or paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-17 of the Administrative Code, an on-site permit by rule or permitted treatment, storage, or disposal facility, or an off-site designated facility.
unit_attributes.scope_text: A generator who accumulates either acute hazardous waste listed in rule 3745-51-31 or paragraph (E) of rule 3745-51-33 of the Administrative Code or non-acute hazardous waste in excess of the amounts listed in paragraph (A) of rule 3745-52-15 at or near any point of generation.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Paragraph (A)(6)(c) establishes ongoing compliance duties during the three-consecutive-calendar-day excess accumulation period.
unit_attributes.statement: During the three-consecutive-calendar-day period when excess acute or non-acute hazardous waste is accumulated, the generator shall continue to comply with paragraphs (A)(1) to (A)(5) of rule 3745-52-15 and shall mark or label the containers holding the excess accumulation of hazardous waste with the date the excess amount began accumulating.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Paragraph (A)(7) specifies preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedural requirements for small quantity generators operating satellite accumulation areas.
unit_attributes.statement: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator shall meet the preparedness and prevention requirements of paragraph (B)(8) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code and emergency procedures of paragraph (B)(9) of rule 3745-52-16 of the Administrative Code.
unit_attributes.scope_text: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a small quantity generator.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Paragraph (A)(8) specifies preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedural requirements for large quantity generators operating satellite accumulation areas.
unit_attributes.statement: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator shall meet the preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedures in rules 3745-52-250 to 3745-52-265 of the Administrative Code.
unit_attributes.scope_text: All satellite accumulation areas operated by a large quantity generator.

unit_attributes.applicability_explanation: Explains where to find referenced publication and regulation dates.
unit_attributes.statement: For dates of non-regulatory government publications, publications of recognized organizations and associations, federal rules, and federal statutory provisions referenced in rule 3745-52-15, see rule 3745-50-11 of the Administrative Code titled "Incorporated by reference."
